title: God blimey if she ain’t a clinker, that there bleeding tart. Blimey it makes me kind of bleeding cry, straight, it does, when I sees her cause I thinks of my old mashtub what’s waiting for me down Limehouse way.
html_source: Sounded a bit negative to my modern ear, but apparently “clinker” is slang for a good looking woman, “tart” simply meant a young woman, “mashtub” is wife, and “Limehouse way” refers to inner London.
